results.title: Ten Reasons to Die After You
results.original_title: As Dez Vantagens de Morrer Depois de Você
results.overview: Devastated by the tragic death of her best friend, Gabriela discovers that she left behind an unexpected parting gift: ten letters containing challenges designed to help her overcome her grief.

results.title: The Mosquito Bowl
results.overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

results.title: Medley
results.overview: Lola (16) is a lonely girl marked by a trauma that has followed her since childhood: the mysterious absence of her father. A talented swimmer with a vast collection of medals, Lola keeps a curious secret, she cannot swim the butterfly stroke. She has a strained relationship with her mother, and after one of their arguments she decides to spend her vacation alone in her uncle's town. There, the teenager's life changes radically she falls in love with Gabriel, makes new friends, and joins the town's struggling swim team. Now, every time Lola is in the water, these new emotions stir memories from her past. On the eve of an important championship, Lola finds herself facing fears and traumas she never expected, including the truth about her father's death.

results.title: Free at Heart
results.overview: Sebastian's (16) sheltered small-town life changes suddenly when his family takes in 15-year-old Kolja, supposedly the son of his father's recently deceased girlfriend. In addition to his little sister, another teenager now lives with them.  Although the two boys are strangers to each other at first, they begin to open up to each other more and more and discover that they are biological brothers. The relationship of trust with his parents breaks down and when Sebastian and Kolja become closer than they expected, Sebastian's life is suddenly turned upside down, as he has found not only a soul mate in his new brother, but also a real, first love. Overwhelmed by their feelings, the two hide their relationship, but when the secret, incestuous relationship is discovered, the family breaks out of the social structure of the small town and comes into conflict with societal norms. Everything that follows is a rollercoaster of emotions.

results.title: Check and Worm
results.overview: Having become ruler, the Queen, generous yet naive, distributes the treasures of the Kingdom to anyone who asks. The experienced councillor however, has objections. A test of dance is held to prove the true intentions of the petitioners. Whoever dances with the greatest ease and grace will be seen as worthy, as this person’s movements are not hindered by the weight of stolen burdens and conscience. During the test, the Queen’s view of the world is irreversibly twisted.

results.title: Fuxi: Four Tales of Feasting
results.overview: Across four millennia, Sun and Moon witness four tales of feasting: from a prehistoric ancestor’s funeral to a mythic king’s spring rite, from a legendary exiled littérateur’s banquet to a waif’s birthday on the eve of modern revolution, where the living and the dead, gods and ghosts gather to savour the everyday joy of food.

results.title: The Mongoose
results.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

results.title: Criaturas – Uma Aventura entre Dois Mundos
results.original_title: Criaturas – Uma Aventura entre Dois Mundos
results.overview: Stela is twelve years old and only believes in what she can see, or not at all. Miguel, the youngest brother, believes in everything, especially in what doesn't exist. Two years after the tragic dive that killed their mother, they return to the mythical city of Paraty, where nothing is what it seems.

results.title: The Blood Countess
results.overview: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

results.title: Nada Sobre Nosotros
results.overview: Gerardo, a short person, suffers a deterioration in his health that gradually affects his mobility. This leads him to implement an idea that has bothered him for a long time; help make people with disabilities visible through the creation of cinematographic stories.

results.title: Notary of Souls
results.overview: Laura, a “young woman” of 126 years old, is the newly hired at Notary of Souls. In her new role, she records the motivations of those who renounced eternity. However, by contract, Laura herself cannot interrupt her tedious existence.

results.title: Das Geheimnis der gestohlenen Maske
results.overview: Does the mask of the Makonde really have magic powers and can it settle the terrible quarrel between Johanna and her best friend? Johanna desperately needs the mask, but before her eyes it is stolen from Leipzig's Grassi Museum and Grandpa Kito is considered the prime suspect! Kito has just appeared from Tanzania and wants the mask, brutally stolen in colonial times, to return to his village. For Johanna, there is more at stake than unmasking the real thief - she must find her own identity.

results.title: Wandering Trees
results.overview: Piero and his son Giuliano live alone, on the edge of town, in a farmhouse filled with injured animals they collect and care for. The Nonne, local notables, want to drive them out because they live like vagrants. During a snowfall, Piero disappears and the animals are killed. Giuliano has no choice but to search for his father.

results.title: Gridlocked
results.overview: A rising prospective attorney messes with a local brothel to uncover sexual abuse and stir’s up a hornet’s nest. As his wife dies under questionable circumstances he connects the dots. Whilst being suspected for murder himself, he has to vanish into the small town’s underground to investigate beyond the eyes of justice.

results.title: Rise of the Empire
results.overview: Upon returning home from his Grand Embassy, Peter the Great enters into a prolonged war with Sweden to secure access to the Baltic Sea. His path to victory is paved with setbacks, treachery, and deceit. Only by overcoming these challenges will he become Emperor, find true love, and establish Russia as a great empire.

results.title: Christmas at the Kringles
results.overview: After moving to a quiet suburban neighborhood, the Seversons meet the Kringles, a family that celebrates Christmas year-round. When Mark, the father, discovers the Kringles' sinister yuletide intentions, he teams up with a badass Santa in a high-stakes, action-packed fight to save his family.

results.title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Four
results.original_title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Four
results.overview: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band have shared the fourth and final installment of “Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour: Philadelphia Freedom Cut,” featuring official video of the full encore from that May 30 show. Kicking off with “American Land” and building to signature live staples “Born to Run,” “Dancing In The Dark” and “Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out,” the performance concludes with The E Street Band version of Bob Dylan’s classic “Chimes Of Freedom.”

results.title: Wind's Howling
results.overview: A medieval fantasy in the world of The Witcher

results.title: Night Ride
results.overview: In a surreal dystopian night, a 5-year-old boy is kidnapped by a mysterious group into the dark.

results.title: Certain Thomas
results.overview: In a world where the United States is replaced by a totalitarian regime governed by flawless algorithmic systems, a young analyst begins to question the math when its cold logic collides with his spiritual beliefs.
